C1686.title: Self-Replicating Worm Hits 180+ npm Packages to Steal Credentials
C1686.summary: ReversingLabs uncovered an npm supply chain attack where over 180 packages were infected with a self-replicating worm designed to steal cloud token credentials. The attack originated from a malicious package named rxnt-authentication, published on npm on September 14, 2025, which leveraged dependency confusion and package typosquatting to compromise CI/CD environments and spread laterally.
